habitat.description:
The tiger prowls through some of the most biodiverse landscapes on Earth, from the steaming mangrove swamps of the Sundarbans to the dense sal forests of central India. These great cats require vast territories of unbroken forest, each individual commanding a home range that may span hundreds of square kilometres of tangled undergrowth, river corridors, and grassland margins.

In the humid tropics of Southeast Asia, tigers move like shadows through cathedral-like stands of dipterocarp trees, their striped coats dissolving into the dappled light that filters through the canopy. The forest floor, thick with leaf litter and crisscrossed by streams, provides perfect cover for ambush hunting.

From the frozen birch forests of the Russian Far East to the tropical dry forests of Rajasthan, the tiger has adapted to an extraordinary range of forested habitats, testament to the remarkable plasticity of this apex predator.

threats.name: Habitat Loss
threats.description: Deforestation for agriculture, palm oil plantations, and urban expansion has reduced tiger habitat by over 95% in the last century.

threats.name: Poaching
threats.description: Illegal hunting for traditional medicine trade, particularly for bones, skins, and other body parts, remains a critical threat.

threats.name: Human-Wildlife Conflict
threats.description: As forests shrink, tigers increasingly encounter human settlements, leading to retaliatory killings when livestock or people are attacked.

threats.name: Prey Depletion
threats.description: Overhunting of deer, wild boar, and other prey species by local communities reduces the food base tigers depend upon.

threats.name: Climate Change
threats.description: Rising sea levels threaten the Sundarbans mangrove habitat, while changing monsoon patterns affect prey availability across the range.

cultural_significance.cinema: From Life of Pi to The Jungle Book, tigers dominate wildlife cinema as symbols of untamed nature and spiritual power.
cultural_significance.literature: William Blake's "Tyger Tyger, burning bright" established the tiger as poetry's most potent symbol of sublime natural force.
cultural_significance.mythology: Sacred in Hindu mythology as the mount of Goddess Durga, and revered across Asian cultures as guardians and shape-shifters.
cultural_significance.media_presence: Tigers appear in more wildlife documentaries than any other big cat, with BBC and National Geographic producing dedicated series.
cultural_significance.cultural_paradox: The most culturally celebrated big cat is simultaneously among the most endangered, with more tigers in captivity than in the wild.

interesting_facts.text: No two tigers have the same stripe pattern; their markings are as unique as human fingerprints.
Tigers can leap forward up to 10 metres in a single bound when attacking prey.
A tiger's roar can be heard from up to 3 kilometres away and can temporarily paralyze prey with fear.
Unlike most cats, tigers are powerful swimmers and often cool off in pools and streams.
There are more tigers in captivity in the United States alone than remain in the wild worldwide.

india_waghoba.description: The Warli tribe of Maharashtra worship Waghoba, a tiger deity believed to protect villages from harm. Shrines at forest edges mark the boundary between human and tiger territory, and rituals ensure peaceful coexistence between communities and the great cats.

india_sundarbans.description: In the Sundarbans mangrove forest, the goddess Bonbibi is worshipped as protector of forest-goers against tiger attacks. Honey collectors and fishers recite her legend before entering the forest, seeking divine protection from the man-eating tigers of the delta.
india_sundarbans.source: Jalais, A. (2010). Forest of Tigers. Routledge.

china_zodiac.description: The tiger is the third animal of the Chinese zodiac, representing bravery, power, and authority. In traditional Chinese medicine, tiger bone was prescribed for joint ailments, driving centuries of demand that contributed to wild population collapse.

korea_horangi.description: The horangi (tiger) is a foundational symbol in Korean culture, appearing in the Dangun creation myth as a patient creature that earned human form. Tigers appear in Korean art as guardians, tricksters, and symbols of Korean identity and resilience.

comic_strip.title: Habitat Under Siege
comic_strip.narrative_text: Deforestation for agriculture, palm oil plantations, and urban expansion has reduced tiger habitat by over 95% in the last century. The relentless conversion of forest to farmland continues to fragment the remaining territories into ever-smaller patches.

comic_strip.label: Fighting Back
comic_strip.title: Project Tiger
comic_strip.narrative_text: India's Project Tiger, launched in 1973, established a network of protected reserves and anti-poaching patrols across the subcontinent. Combined with the TX2 Goal and Global Tiger Initiative, these programs have helped reverse decades of decline.

comic_strip.label: The Future
comic_strip.title: A Fragile Recovery
comic_strip.narrative_text: With an estimated population of 4,500 and an increasing trend, tigers represent a rare conservation success. However, this recovery remains fragile as habitat loss continues and the majority of the population depends on just a handful of well-protected reserves.

tmdb_media.title: The Conservation Game
tmdb_media.overview: Retired Ohio police officer, Tim Harrison, stumbles upon a bombshell discovery when he suspects that the world's most famous celebrity conservationists may be secretly connected to the big cat trade.

tmdb_media.title: Tiger
tmdb_media.overview: Journey alongside a young tigress raising her cubs in the fabled forests of India.

tmdb_media.title: Tiger Cruise
tmdb_media.overview: On its last leg homeward, from Pearl Harbor, Hawaii to San Diego, the USS Constellation hosts a jolly "tiger cruise" for US Navy, Marines and USNAF relatives, mainly minors ("Navy brats"). Attitudes and emotions vary from simple joy to open frustration, the worst brat being XO commander Gary Dolan's daughter Maddie, who wants him to refuse a promotion to command for a shore job. Then the news of the WCC terror crisis changes everything, as the crew is recalled to war footing.

tmdb_media.title: The Tiger Rising
tmdb_media.overview: When 12-year-old Rob Horton discovers a caged tiger in the woods near his home, his imagination runs wild and life begins to change in the most unexpected ways. With the help of a wise and mysterious maid, Willie May  and the stubborn new girl in school, he must navigate through childhood memories, heartache, and wondrous adventures.

tmdb_media.title: Tiger
tmdb_media.overview: Working at a men-only massage shop and hopping between gay porn auditions, Tiger heads to his hometown one day after hearing his father is critically ill. His father intends to leave the house to his son and the dental clinic to his daughter. However, his sister denies Tiger’s right to inherit, threatening him with the prospect of outing him. Through time spent with a married friend he hasn’t seen in years and while looking after his young niece, Tiger realizes that he also wants to be part of a ‘family’ and begins to explore ways to build one in his own way through a ‘friendship marriage.’
